description: Shift grid model JTSK03 is a dataset listed in INSPIRE Discovery Service Slovakia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportal.sk. Shift grid model JTSK03 is a digital model for transforming horizontal coordinates between the implementation of S-JTSK (JTSK03) and S-JTSK (JTSK). Coverage: SK. Its keywords include NADCON, JTSK, NTv2, JTSK03. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-csw-sk.
